summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing five Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns dated October 12-16, 2026, disclosing on-market share repurchases for cancellation under Main Board Rule 13.25A. Disclosed buybacks between July 1 and late July 2026 range roughly 77,000-135,000 shares per session at prices near USD 1.04-1.09, each under 0.06% of issued shares. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction price is specified. Mechanics reflect an ongoing open-market buyback program with repurchased shares pending cancellation; watch cumulative repurchase pace, cancellation timing, and any acceleration signaling management's valuation view.
